messages.content: I want to graduate with Honours. What is the minimum CGPA I need and are there any other restrictions?

To graduate with Honours, you must have a CGPA of 8.5 or above AND you must have passed every single course on your first attempt, meaning you cannot have any backlogs or failures in any semester. If you have any backlogs, you are permanently ineligible for Honours, regardless of your final CGPA.
If I failed one elective in my 3rd semester but cleared it in a backlog, can I still get Honours if my final CGPA is 9.0?
No, you cannot get Honours. Having a backlog in any semester, even if you cleared it later, permanently disqualifies you from graduating with Honours, regardless of your final CGPA.
My attendance in 'Software Engineering' is 68%. Will I be allowed to sit for the exams?

With an attendance of 68% in 'Software Engineering', you are below the 75% required to be eligible for the End-Semester Examination. However, since your attendance is above 65%, you may be eligible for condonation, subject to approval by the condonation committee.
What happens if my attendance drops to 60%?
If your attendance drops to 60%, you will be detained and awarded a grade 'F'. All your marks for the semester will be cancelled, and you will have to repeat the course.

I am in an even semester. Can I register for a 3rd-semester (Odd) backlog in Mode 'b' right now?

You are in an even semester and want to register for a 3rd-semester (Odd) backlog in Mode 'b'. According to the registration rules, Mode 'b' is permissible only if the student had registered in mode 'a' and fulfilled attendance requirement in an earlier semester. However, since you didn't provide the course code, I couldn't verify the course details. 

To proceed, please provide the course code of the 3rd-semester backlog you want to register for. I'll then be able to check the course details and provide a more accurate answer.
Wait, I have a backlog in 'Applied Mathematics-I' (AMS1112) from my 1st semester. Can I take that one right now?

Since 'Applied Mathematics-I' (AMS1112) is a first-year course, you can register for it in any semester, regardless of the current semester parity. The registration rules permit the registration of first-year courses in all semesters. Therefore, you can take 'Applied Mathematics-I' (AMS1112) right now.
I have finished my 4th semester with a total of 62 credits. However, I only earned 34 credits in my first year. Am I eligible for promotion to the 5th semester?

You are not eligible for promotion to the 5th semester because you have not met the required 60 earned credits, including at least 36 credits from the first two semesters, by the end of Semester IV. You have only earned 34 credits in your first year and a total of 62 credits by the end of your 4th semester.
What if I take a 4-credit course during a special summer session? Can that count toward my first-year total for promotion?
Taking a 4-credit course during a special summer session does not count toward your first-year total for promotion.
